method: 2D TMz Yee grid (Ez, Hx, Hy), periodic in x (real fields), CPML in y, soft additive Ez sheet across the full period with the shared Gaussian pulse, staircase Yee material sampling, DFT lines of Ez and Hx at the reflection and transmission rows (trilinear interpolation to the pixel centres in x, H carries its half-step phase), bare-substrate reference run with the same settings. Fields are the solver's reduced units; compare.py forms ratios.

grid.boundary: CPML, cubic sigma profile sigma=40*rho^3/(L+1) in Courant units, kappa=1, alpha=1e-8

phasor_convention: DFT = dt*sum(f(t) exp(+2 pi i f t)); a +y travelling wave is exp(+i k_y y); H sampled at t+dt/2 with its phase applied

reflection.flux_units: reduced E*H * s^2 * m per invariant length

transmission.flux_units: reduced E*H * s^2 * m per invariant length
